card.name: The word per before day in doses
card.fires_on: The word "per" right after a dose amount (mg, mg/kg, tablet, mL) when "day" is expected next. Also "from" before a gestation or study day.

modes.label: per day after dose
modes.description: "per" follows an amount and leads into "day" in a dosing instruction.
modes.example: Do not exceed 75 mg<< per>> day. (2.1,

modes.label: from before day range
modes.description: "from" introduces a start day in animal study dosing.
modes.example: 2 mg/kg or 4 mg/kg diclofenac (0.1 and 0.2 times the MRHD based on BSA)<< from>> Gestation Day 15 through L

card.writes: It pushes the model toward daily and session-type words, such as "daily" and "session".
card.plain: It fires on "per" in "mg per day" when a daily amount is being given.
